item.title: Merriam-Webster’s 2025 word of the year is 'slop'
item.description: Creepy, zany and demonstrably fake content is often called “slop.” The word's proliferation online, in part thanks to the widespread availability of generative artificial intelligence, landed it Merriam-Webster's 2025 word of the year .

item.title: Rob Reiner and his wife found dead in Los Angeles home, AP source says
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Director-actor Rob Reiner and his wife Michele were the two people found dead Sunday at a Los Angeles home owned by Reiner, according to a law enforcement official briefed on the investigation.

item.title: B.C. braces for 'high impact' rain in flood-struck Fraser Valley and beyond
item.description: British Columbia is bracing for another "high impact" deluge of rain that's forecast to hit the province's Fraser Valley, after intense downpours and cross-border outflows last week inundated Abbotsford, triggered evacuations and cut major highways.

item.title: Former Hong Kong pro-democracy media mogul Jimmy Lai convicted in landmark national security trial
item.description: HONG KONG (AP) — Jimmy Lai , the pro-democracy former Hong Kong media mogul and outspoken critic of Beijing, was convicted in a landmark national security trial in the city’s court on Monday, which could send him to prison for the rest of his life.

item.title: Rob Reiner's life in photos
item.description: Rob Reiner, one of the preeminent filmmakers of his generation who directed movies such as “The Princess Bride,” “When Harry Met Sally …” and “This Is Spinal Tap,” died Sunday at 78.

item.title: Australian Prime Minister Albanese proposes tougher national gun laws after mass shooting in Sydney
item.description: SYDNEY (AP) — Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese on Monday proposed tougher national gun laws after a mass shooting targeted a Hanukkah celebration on Sydney's Bondi Beach , leaving at least 15 people dead.

item.title: Rob Reiner mourned by Barack Obama, Jerry O'Connell, James Woods and many others
item.description: Reactions to the death of actor-director Rob Reiner , who was found dead with his wife Michele Reiner at their home in Los Angeles on Sunday.

item.title: Rob Reiner, son of a comedy giant who became one, too, dies at 78
item.description: Rob Reiner, the son of a comedy giant who went on to become one, himself, as one of the preeminent filmmakers of his generation with movies such as “The Princess Bride,” “When Harry Met Sally …” and “This Is Spinal Tap,” has died. He was 78.
